ITEM.PTXT: The ball joint mechanism consists of a flange with a spherical surface, and bolts and springs that support the seal portion of the gasket. Compared to a flexible pipe, it can be made more compact and can be installed at the optimum position with respect to vibration.
Vibration and noise are reduced by absorbing vibration from the engine and resonance vibration of the exhaust pipe with the ball joint (spherical portion of the flange and gasket).
